name: Rousette
what_it_is: A full RESTCONF server (RFC 8040) built on top of sysrepo, providing XML and JSON data encoding, YANG module library access, NACM access control, and NETCONF notification streams over cleartext HTTP/2. It is designed to run behind a reverse proxy (e.g., nghttpx) that handles TLS termination.
components: nghttpx (recommended reverse proxy for TLS termination)
measurement: No built-in metrics endpoint; logging via spdlog to stdout, syslog, or systemd journal
Sysrepo operation timeout configurable via --timeout <SECONDS> CLI flag
Test suite uses doctest framework with per-test server port assignment starting at 10080
configuration: Server binds to ::1 (IPv6 loopback) on port 10080 by default (hardcoded in main.cpp)
Anonymous access user/group configurable at build time via CMake options ANONYMOUS_USER (default: yangnobody) and ANONYMOUS_USER_GROUP (default: yangnobody)
Authentication via PAM Basic HTTP auth; pam_wrapper used for test mocking
NACM rules configured through ietf-netconf-acm YANG model in sysrepo
Reverse proxy must forward the Authorization header unchanged
Required YANG models must be pre-installed in sysrepo: ietf-yang-library@2019-01-04, ietf-netconf, ietf-restconf@2017-01-26, ietf-restconf-monitoring@2017-01-26, ietf-yang-patch@2017-02-22
Logging destination selectable via --syslog flag or auto-detected journald
fault_injection: Tests use unshare + mount (Linux namespaces) to isolate PAM and tmpfs environments
pam_matrix/pam_wrapper used to mock PAM authentication outcomes in tests
trompeloeil mock objects used for C++ unit test stubbing
modes: Normal operation: cleartext HTTP/2 behind reverse proxy
Debug mode: direct curl --http2-prior-knowledge access without proxy
Anonymous access mode: request without Authorization header mapped to ANONYMOUS_USER if NACM rules allow
Authenticated mode: HTTP Basic auth via PAM
constraints: TLS termination is NOT implemented; a reverse proxy is required for HTTPS
TLS certificate authentication is NOT supported
Last-Modified and ETag headers for edit collision prevention are NOT implemented
with-operational-default and with-origin NMDA capabilities are NOT implemented
Binds only to ::1 (IPv6 loopback) by default; external access requires reverse proxy or code change
Requires Linux (uses unshare/mount for test isolation; PAM is Linux-specific)
Requires C++20 compiler (GCC 10+ or clang 10+) and CMake 3.19+
Anonymous access requires very specific NACM rule ordering to be enabled
notable_absences: No docker-compose or Dockerfile in the repository
No REST API for metrics or health checks
No built-in rate limiting or connection throttling
No support for Last-Modified/ETag edit collision prevention headers
No YANG datastore diff or audit log endpoint
Development is done on Gerrit (not GitHub); GitHub PRs are not accepted
